programme.title: Eu Sofri

Em 2016, o youtuber Henrique Marangon, mais conhecido como Core, recebeu uma mensagem de declaração de um fã, propondo um encontro entre os dois. Depois de recusar o convite, Core começou a sofrer perseguições e ameaças, as quais durariam até os próximos oito anos. O criminoso, além de assediar o youtuber, também passou a perseguir a esposa dele, chegando a proferir ameaças de teor neonazista contra ela. programme.title: Investigação Criminal Internacional

Ao mesmo tempo em que espalhou terror e destruição para sustentar seu império criminoso, conquistou a admiração da população com carisma e ações sociais, tornando-se o centro da atenções do mundo na década de 1980. programme.title: Planeta Sheen
programme.desc: Dorkus planeja que Pinter e Doppy troquem de lugar por um dia para ele poder se aproximar de Sheen e destruí-lo. / Zeenu é atacada por um enxame dos bárbaros "puxa cuecas" e somente Sheen pode para-los.

programme.title: Sonic Underground

programme.title: Sonic Underground

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Os Freedom Fighters, com a nova adição, Dulcy, desenvolvem um De-Roboti-sizer e testam-no em Bunnie. É um sucesso e, contra a vontade de Sally, Sonic enfrenta a mais nova arma de Robotnik – um Shriek-Bot de Realidade Virtual.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Zig & Sharko

programme.title: Zig & Sharko
programme.desc: Sharko e Marina estão assistindo a um filme de vampiros, o que as assusta. Zig e Bernie decidem usar táticas de vampiro para aterrorizar Sharko e sequestrar a sereia. Mas não é fácil jogar Drácula ...

programme.title: Zig & Sharko

programme.title: Zig & Sharko
programme.desc: Zig e Sharko apresentam o melhor coquetel de frutas e decidem abrir uma lanchonete na praia. Os negócios vão bem até a Marina aparecer ...

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada
programme.desc: Lula Molusco faz plástica e fica muito bonito. Agora todas as meninas da Fenda do Bikini estão apaixonadas por ele. / O corpo do Bob Esponja está produzindo música. Atraídas pelo som, todas as águas-vivas começam a segui-lo.

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada
programme.desc: Lula Molusco quer provar a todos que sua casa é a mais chique da Fenda do Bikini. / Plankton consegue fugir da cadeia e vai mais uma vez tentar roubar a fórmula secreta do hambúrguer de siri.

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada
programme.desc: Bob Esponja encontra uma moeda no chão e o ambicioso Sr. Sirigueijo vai fazer de tudo para pegar a moeda para ele. / Bob Esponja tem que decorar toda a historia da pilotagem de barco em apenas uma noite.

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada

programme.title: Bob Esponja Calça Quadrada
programme.desc: Lula Molusco tenta fugir de Bob e acaba levando uma multa de trânsito por excesso de velocidade. / Para o novo tablóide do sr. Siriguejo, Bob quer escrever a verdade. Mas o sr. Sirigueijo quer 'impacto e escândalo', seja verdade ou não.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: Sharing the joys and traditions of the holiday season with your little one is truly one of the greatest gifts of parenthood, and Baby Santa's Music Box makes this magical time even more special! Celebrate by treating your baby and yourself to a captivating wonderland of bright lights, sparkling ornaments, sleigh bells, toys, winter scenes, jolly Santas and more -- all accompanied by beloved holiday melodies.

programme.title: Baby Einstein New Classics
programme.desc: Journey to the classroom with your favorite Baby Einstein friends! Learn about what makes your face incredible, baby's first sounds, and counting in different languages with a focus on Spanish! Real-life engaging imagery, upbeat classical melodies and gentle narration and repetition introduce first words, faces and a variety of different languages to young viewers.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: As babies develop, their understanding of the world, and how its pieces "fit" together, continues to progress. DISCOVERING SHAPES playfully introduces five basic forms circle, oval, triangle, square and rectangle as each appears in the context of toys, nature and everyday objects.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: One of the greatest joys you'll ever experience is bonding with your baby during those calm, quiet moments. Lullaby Time: Soothing Sounds for Baby provides comforting sights and sounds as you relax and share this precious downtime.

programme.title: Baby Einstein New Classics
programme.desc: Discover the wonderful world of water and deep dive into all the amazing creatures that call the ocean home. Learn simple words about the sea like water, coral reef, and ocean through narration and repetition. Engaging live-action footage of your favorite ocean friends and classical melodies will dazzle your little explorer as they experience the magical world under the sea.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: Dive in with your little explorer across the seas to meet amazing animals living in the ocean, coral reef, and polar regions. Overflowing with underwater footage of whales, dolphins, tropical fish, and more, Neptune's Oceans invites you and your baby on an oceanic voyage of discovery!

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: World Music introduces you and your little one to beautiful sounds from every continent, bringing a fresh, new experience of music and culture. Sing, dance and play to exotic rhythms that open the door to an appreciation of different cultures from around the world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: From the day their eyes open, babies begin to observe new things around the world and about themselves. Baby Da Vinci From Head to Toe presents them with a playful and interactive introduction to the human body in three languages -- English, Spanish, and French. With a whimsical blend of adorable puppets, real children and animals and famous works of art, this captivating program also features upbeat classical music.

programme.title: Baby Einstein New Classics
programme.desc: Sing along to your favorite classical melodies and enjoy engaging imagery in this space and sky themed episode. Young viewers can learn words like star and moon through repetition and narration, explore with the Baby Einstein characters, or simply dance along.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Ocean Explorers
programme.desc: Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

programme.title: Cal's Sound Yard
programme.desc: Cal's Sound Yard is a new animated series from Baby Einstein that introduces the letters of the alphabet and the sounds they make.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy está pilotando a nave espacial que substitui a estação espacial orbitando a Terra! Abandonando seu traje espacial, Oggy se sente em casa, sentado confortavelmente em sua almofada.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy acaba de comprar uma máquina de teletransporte. Agora ele pode ir às compras sem se cansar: ele é transportado para a loja, em seguida, aperta o botão do controle remoto e é transportado de volta para casa

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas: Pólo Norte Panic | Um cara encantador
programme.desc: Véspera de Natal no Pólo Norte, onde a fábrica de brinquedos está mais movimentada do que nunca. Os pinguins trabalham sem parar. Disfarçado de pinguim, as baratas sequestram o Papai Noel!

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Olivia decide surpreender Oggy e o leva a uma antiga fazenda no interior. Não é exatamente o destino dos sonhos de Oggy.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy conhece um cão adorável que desapareceu. Tocado pelos olhos úmidos do jovem filhote, ele imediatamente o acolhe.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy encontra um garotinho perdido na rua. Ele deixa Jack como babá, enquanto ele sai em busca dos pais. Jack leva a criança para passear, mas as baratas têm planos. Depois de serem maltratados pelo menino, eles querem vingança.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Quando o sanduíche de Oggy é roubado no canteiro de obras da catedral de Notre Dame, ele pensa que são as baratas de novo ... Mas não! É o Quasimodo, o corcunda. Ele e Oggy tornam-se amigos rapidamente e, juntos, protegem Olivia - a adorável cigana.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Durante a proibição, Dee Dee é designada por Joey e Marky para conseguir comida enlatada. Dee Dee está determinado a competir com Al Capone. Mas Oggy expõe Dee Dee e interrompe seu negócio, que deixa pessoas morrendo de fome em toda a cidade.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Por causa dos poderes mágicos da luneta de uma bruxa, os papéis dos habitantes da casa são invertidos: as baratas agora são tão grandes quanto Oggy, enquanto os gatos ficam tão pequenos quanto as baratas!

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy pega Dee-Dee em flagrante roubando comida de sua geladeira. Para fugir do aperto do gato, a barata finge estar morta. Seus companheiros e cúmplices chamam imediatamente a polícia e Oggy é acusado de assassinato!

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Edo, capital do Japão durante a Idade Média. Oggy está em conflito com Lord Bob. Olivia sugere que eles resolvam suas diferenças com uma cerimônia de luta de sumô. Olivia faz questão de ajudar seu concorrente a vencer, mas as baratas interferem ...

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Uma mãe ouriço encontra Dee-Dee no pomar e o adota como seu bebê. Joey e Marky riem ao ver Dee-Dee vestida de garotinha. Depois de boas gargalhadas, as duas baratas decidem dar-lhe uma ajuda...

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Oggy - um ceramista - recebe a honrosa missão de restaurar o precioso vaso Ming do imperador. Mas as baratas, convencidas de que está cheio de arroz, ficam obcecadas. Eles devem ter aquele vaso! Oggy pode encontrar uma maneira de protegê-lo?

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Durante uma das muitas sessões de baratas, DeeDee cai no fundo de um iogurte de morango sem saber que Oggy, também com fome, engole tudo de um só gole!

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas: Jogue fora as baratas! | A Cucaracha | Vamos festejar, pessoal!
programme.desc: Oggy e Jack encontram um novo emprego: eles se tornam lixeiros! E eles vão esvaziar as latas de lixo da vizinhança de manhã cedo. Que sorte a deles que as baratas estivessem na primeira lata de lixo que nossos gatos pegaram.

programme.title: Oggy e as Baratas Tontas
programme.desc: Devido a um fenômeno climático estranho, o sol está brilhando na casa de Oggy, mas em todos os outros lugares está chovendo torrencialmente. Jack decide aproveitar a situação e transformar a casa em um clube.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Cosmo e Wanda levam Timmy a uma viagem pelo tempo para que ele conheça alguns de seus afilhados do passado. Mas as coisas não saem conforme o esperado quando Timmy interfere no passado e altera todo o futuro.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: O pai de Timmy organiza um programa de vigilância na vizinhança para capturar um ladrão do bairro. / Timmy deseja ter a família perfeita para ganhar um concurso, mas os Turners enlouquecem tentando ser perfeitos.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: O pai de Timmy proíbe Sparky de sair com a cachorrinha do Senhor Dinkleberg. / Quando a mãe de Timmy não para de incomodar seu filho e seu marido, o garoto deseja que todas as mulheres do universo desapareçam por um dia.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Quando Timmy percebe que todo mundo em Dimmsdale tem um bicho de estimação, menos ele, ele adota Sparky (Faísca), um cachorro mágico travesso.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Timmy deseja que o sr. Dinkelberg substitua o pai do cargo de líder dos esquilinhos. O pai do Timmy tenta recuperar o respeito do filho e a posição de líder. / Cosmo sofre de amnésia e pensa que o pai dele é um gênio.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Crocker procura uma nova fonte de magia na casa de Timmy. Percebendo que é Sparky, Crocker tenta virá-lo contra Timmy. / Crocker se classifica na curva de Gauss, então Timmy deseja que todos fossem mais burros do que ele.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Poof passa pela experiência dos terríveis dois anos. Foop passa pela experiência dos incríveis dois anos. / Timmy deseja ter o smartphone mais legal do mundo. O celular tem de tudo, mas logo começa a dominar a vida de Timmy.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Na limpeza de um parque, Timmy deseja que todos os animais limpassem as sujeiras deles. Os animais se unem e iniciam um ataque geral contra Timmy / Timmy ajuda a mãe a fazer um vídeo viral. Crocker vê e acha que a mãe é um troll

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Foop torna-se o padrinho anti-fada de Vicky. Vicky e Foop aterrorizam Timmy e as crianças de Dimmsdale. Foop conta para Vicky que o motivo de Timmy frustrá-la durante todos esses anos é porque ele tem padrinhos mágicos.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Foop e Poof precisam tomar conta de um ovo para um trabalho da escola. Foop o quebra e o troca por um ovo perigoso. / Chet Ubetcha larga o emprego. O pai de Timmy se torna o novo repórter.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Timmy gosta de uma nova garota na escola. Ele deseja ser "emo" e deixa de se importar com tudo. / Timmy e as fadas livrar a casa dele do pó de fada. O porão ganha vida. Os pais de Timmy vão para um spa falso.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: O pai está deprimido porque todos os acham chato. Timmy deseja que a vida do pai seja igual a de um filme de ação / Timmy e seus pais são convidados para o country club. Cosmo briga com um esquilo. Timmy deseja virar socialite

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Timmy se dá conta de que tem que compartilhar seus padrinhos mágicos com Chloe Carmichael, uma nova garota chegou a sua escola. O problema é que o primeiro desejo da garota é que todos compartilham tudo, o que instaura o caos.

programme.title: Os Padrinhos Mágicos
programme.desc: Catman acredita que Timmy foi sequestrado. Ele confunde Chloe com a Catgirl e pede ajuda á garota para resgatar Timmy. / Timmy deseja que seu pai seja prefeito, mas ele não tem ideia das consequências que seu pedido pode trazer.

programme.title: Beyblade Burst

programme.title: Rampaging Rivals episode 8
programme.desc: As Ernest terrorizes Daedo with the Leobot, the gang arrives on the scene and unleashes the full force of the Tobot army. But when Boss Karr arrives to back up Ernest with the Road Ripper and Ryan and Kory accidentally mix up their Tobots’ commands, the villains gain the advantage and the Rescue Crew must take up Kaylee, Ben and Chuck on their offer to pilot them.

programme.title: I Dream of Neo Tritan episode 9
programme.desc: With the Dalloway gang’s robots wreaking havoc throughout Daedo City, the boys are eager to get X, Y, and Z’s new integration firmware uploaded, but Franklin and Limo have been recruited by the Space Program to help build a base on the moon. The Rescue Crew decide to reveal their creator’s identity, but little do they know that the mysterious Dr. Zinc is already collaborating with Limo and Franklin on the lunar mission. With all the experts too busy to upload the new firmware, Ryan decides to take matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie encounter Eugene’s latest invention – an android lookalike – and Boss Karr hatches a plot to infiltrate the moon program.

programme.title: Moonshots and Masquerades episode 10
programme.desc: The gang settle into Project Whitesail HQ, where the Rescue Crew have an awkward reunion with Maggie (Dr. Zinc), unaware she’s been replaced by team Dalloway’s doppelganger. Franklin and Limo get to work, and the boys explore their new base of operations. After hearing an inspiring anecdote from the project director, Ryan decides to start beta-testing the updated Tritanware. Meanwhile, Boss Karr and Valerie attack downtown Daedo City, hoping to distract the Tobots from their presence at Whitesail HQ, and it’s up to Kaylee, Chuck, and Ben to stop them. M, P, and L arrive on the scene, but Boss Karr’s latest battle bot has a secret weapon that prevents them from forming Rescue 3.

programme.title: Blowouts and Bad Influences episode 11
programme.desc: After a game of hot pursuit with the Rebbots, the Tobots find themselves caught in a sticky trap thanks to a double-dose of the Dalloway Gang’s new machines. After a rough scramble, our heroes manage to escape their concrete captivity and must strike back with a Rescue 3/Neo Tritan double whammy.

programme.title: Dodging Defeat episode 1
programme.desc: Robot Dodgeball pilot Taren Swift strives to be champion, hoping to follow in his grandfather's footsteps. Little does he know, the new pilots on the scene have other plans for him. Meanwhile, two mysterious troublemakers approach the city from afar.

programme.desc: The whole team's excited when Dr. Hughes finally installs the new Mind Cores into Taren's upgraded Athlons, but a strange reaction catches everyone off-guard. While they're distracted, a new Robot Dodgeball contestant reveals her motives and plots her course to victory.

programme.desc: The Athlon team's Dodgeball training session crashes and burns when the new additions prove tough to work with. Tori investigates the competition in hopes of discovering which player's sabotaging the tournament. Lola launches an evil new game plan that lets her hide in plain sight.

programme.title: Kenan e Kel

programme.title: I'M LIVE - sogumm episode 233
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - nokdu episode 234
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - WeAreYoung episode 235
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: A Feast of Spring Flowers
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating Folding Screens: Pasting Master
programme.desc: Baechup is the traditional Korean technique for mounting calligraphy and paintings to enhance their preservation and beauty. Appreciate the master's craftmanship as he create a traditional ten-panel folding screen. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Echoes of a Thousand Years: Musical Instrument Master
programme.desc: At the heart of Korean rhythm is the janggu, the traditional hourglass drum. From wood shaping to skin tightening, each step carries a legacy of sound and craftsmanship. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Rising with the Wind: Kite Making Master
programme.desc: Paper and bamboo come together in the hands of a skilled artisan to create a traditional kite. Every cut and brushstroke carries care, as the kite soars with hopes into the sky. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Patience: Ottchil Master
programme.desc: A Ottchil Master is an artisan skilled in decorating objects and furniture surfaces beautifully with ottchil (natural varnish/lacquer) and shells. Appreciate the works filled with the dedication and patience of the Lacquerware Master. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Bowl Made by the Sea: Tongyeong Neomul Bibimbap
programme.desc: There are various regional versions of traditional bibimbap, but Tongyeong's version is accompanied by tofu soup. Experience the special bibimbap of Tongyeong. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: A Feast of Spring Flowers
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: Reed Swaying in the Wind, Suncheon Bay
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.2
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)
